title: How coffee chains like Costa lost the matcha generation
summary: Costa's owner Coca-Cola is reportedly looking to sell the chain as its popularity cools off. So has something gone wrong?

title: How colorful do we want our food to be? American shoppers have a say
summary: As more major food brands commit to phasing out chemical dyes from snacks and cereals in the U.S., some are struggling to find natural replacements. Many consumers say they want bright colors.
